text.T004:
The technical system and the human operating model have to work together. These are the
      questions behind my writing.
text.T006:
In UA, Thinking Systems are identified by material runtime responsibilities that depend
        partly on probabilistic Model Judgment. The category is about an engineering condition, not
        consciousness or a guarantee of reliability.
text.T007:
Judgment Nodes locate where model judgment influences behavior; Uncertainty Boundaries
        connect deterministic responsibilities with that judgment.
text.T011:
My AI governance work applies control-theory ideas to boundaries, evidence, decision
        authority and corrective action. UA's AI Control Plane is a distributed capability model
        across software, evaluation, release decisions and human workflows — not necessarily a
        central platform.
text.T015:
Which model-mediated outputs, decisions or actions can materially affect outcomes,
        constraints, authority or downstream people and systems? That question helps connect AI
        architecture with evaluation, release evidence and accountability.
text.T019:
I study the socio-technical stack around AI: how team roles, review practices, decision
        rights, evaluation and incident ownership fit together. AI governance is not only a model
        setting; it also concerns how people operate and change the system.
text.T023:
These Reddit exchanges include practical suggestions, alternative explanations and technical
      criticism.
